notes: Cấp đủ quyền cần cho toàn vòng đời dự án ngay từ đầu, không cấp nhỏ giọt.
Không dùng Global API Key hoặc wildcard toàn tài khoản nếu quyền project-scoped đáp ứng được.
Secret value không lưu trong repo/Google Sheet/log. Chỉ lưu secret name/reference.
APK/signing đang DEFERRED nên chưa tạo signer/key Android ở giai đoạn này.

github.current_connector_observation: admin/push access already observed on repository

forbidden: API Tokens Write unless OWNER explicitly wants token-factory automation

google_cloud.scope_policy: Prefer drive.file plus exact folder/file allowlist. Escalate to full drive only if a required server-side workflow cannot operate with drive.file and OWNER explicitly approves.
google_cloud.drive_access: Service identity must receive writer access only to the new VẬN HÀNH DC HƯNG YÊN root/resources needed by runtime.
google_cloud.gmail: Send-only scope; no inbox read/modify required for OTP/reset mail unless OWNER later changes requirement.

google_drive_chatgpt.rule: ChatGPT Drive operations for this project must stay inside registered new-project resources except explicit read-only legacy reference reads.

domain.dns_zone: existing zone may be reused; only new project records/routes are allowed

manual_owner_actions: Create Cloudflare custom API token with permissions in this manifest and add it to the new GitHub repository Actions secrets.

Create a new Google Cloud project for Vận hành DC Hưng Yên, enable Drive/Sheets/Gmail APIs, create runtime identity/OAuth configuration, and grant the runtime identity access only to the new Drive project root/resources.
Create/link a new Apps Script project to the new Google Cloud project if Apps Script compatibility/admin jobs are retained.
Add resulting non-public credentials to GitHub Actions secrets; do not paste secrets into repository files or Sheets.
